channel.title: Platform Engineering Notes (sample feed)
channel.description: A small hand-written RSS feed used to demo the crawler offline.

item.title: Rotating PostgreSQL credentials without downtime
item.description: Create a second role, deploy the new secret, then drop the old role once connection pools have drained. Works with pgbouncer too.

item.title: Why our Docker images got 70% smaller
item.content:encoded: Multi-stage builds: compile the frontend in a node builder stage, then copy only dist/ and production dependencies into a slim runtime image.

item.title: Incident review: crawler stampede on the docs site
item.description: An unthrottled internal crawler ignored robots.txt and hammered the documentation site. Fixes: per-host delay, conditional GET with ETag, and honouring Disallow rules.
